# PyAutoLens Visualization Gallery

<!-- Generated by gallery/gallery_build.py from scripts/<domain>/images/. Do not edit by hand: rerun `bash gallery/gallery_run.sh --all`. -->

Rendered with PyAutoLens `2026.8.17.1` · 64 figures.

Every figure below is what the PyAutoLens visualizers (`VisualizerImaging`, `VisualizerInterferometer`, `VisualizerPoint`, `VisualizerWeak`) write to a model-fit's `image/` folder, rendered on this repo's datasets with the true model. See [README.md](README.md) for how to improve one.
